n_stages_note: 11 registry stages cover all 12 rows listed in the consolidation protocol: 'Dynamic V2 / MF-TSR' and 'MF-TSR validation' describe the same stage (V2-MF-TSR); the protocol-correction stage is listed separately as V2-PROTOCOL-CORRECTION.

stages.stage_name: Formal E1 — Causal Encoder (random vs UMER init)
stages.commit_note: finalization commit 26029af (fold-parity audit, cap-aware diagnostic, epochs_run fix)
stages.split_note: The encoder is trained on the training fold; every E1 Macro-F1 reported here is a validation-fold readout, so the reported evidence split is VALIDATION, not TRAIN.
stages.main_objective: Train a causally-constructed propagation encoder on real cutoffs; test whether the causal initialization (UMER init) beats random init.
stages.gate_definition: Readiness gate for downstream stages: UMER init must be at least as good as random init at every primary cutoff.
known_caveats: The UMER-vs-random advantage is small (0.6-1.5 pt Macro-F1) and measured on validation only.
Finalization found a fold-parity issue in the first submission; corrected in 26029af but E1 itself was not retrained.
protocol_issues_discovered_later: The later no-candidate snapshot correction (V2 protocol correction) showed that all early-cutoff evaluation must keep candidate_count = 0 events; E1's source-only vs cutoff-conditioned comparison is not affected because E1 never drops events, but the correction changed the E2/E3 metric denominator used downstream.

stages.stage_name: Corrected E2 — Static Utility Selector readiness
stages.commit_note: first (invalid) E2 submission 1c987f1 retained under results/tcdscr/formal_e2/
stages.main_objective: Train the static utility selector and verify it beats simple baselines (random selection, semantic similarity) under the frozen encoder.
stages.gate_definition: readiness gate: static Macro-F1 - best simple baseline >= 0.005 on both datasets

actual_outcome.historical_readiness_note: The readiness gate was evaluated with the candidate-conditioned metric (candidate_count > 0). It is retained for audit and must not be cited as the paper's absolute metric.
actual_outcome.canonical_note: The protocol correction changed the absolute values but not the direction or the dataset-level conclusion (PHEME below the 0.005 readiness threshold, Ma-Weibo clearly positive).

known_caveats: The effect is dataset-dependent: +2.1 pt on Ma-Weibo but +0.22 pt on PHEME (below the 0.5 pt readiness threshold).
The first E2 submission was INVALID due to a proxy train/eval contract mismatch; its numbers must not be cited.
protocol_issues_discovered_later: The corrected-E2 metric was conditioned on candidate_count > 0; the later all-event correction changed the absolute values (PHEME static 0.85572 -> 0.85669, Ma-Weibo unchanged in direction).

stages.stage_name: E3 / Dynamic V1 validation — point-wise novelty+persistence reranking
stages.main_objective: Add a point-wise temporal dynamic bonus (novelty + persistence) on top of static utility and check whether it improves early detection on validation.
stages.gate_definition: readiness gate for the held-out test: dynamic - static Macro-F1 >= 0.005 with no flip-rate blow-up, on both datasets
known_caveats: Validation readiness passed, but the held-out test did not confirm it (see E3-TEST).
The later score-scale diagnosis showed the dynamic bonus std is only 1.9-3.9% of the utility std, which explains why reranking rarely changes the selection.
protocol_issues_discovered_later: E3 validation used the pre-correction metric that conditioned on candidate_count > 0; the all-event re-diagnostic is recorded in dynamic_v2_protocol/e3_v1_all_event_diagnostic.json.

model_components_used: frozen 30 fold configs (5 folds x 3 seeds)
stages.main_objective: Confirm the Dynamic V1 validation gain on the untouched outer test split.
stages.gate_definition: dynamic - static Macro-F1 > 0 with bootstrap CI excluding 0
known_caveats: Positive point estimates on both datasets but both bootstrap CIs cross zero; the method is not established as an improvement.
The bootstrap CI in the original E3 test artifact lost multiplicity; see PROTOCOL_CORRECTIONS.

SCOPE AUDIT (consolidation finalization): the held-out runner dropped event-cutoffs with candidate_count == 0 (173,277 of 199,602 expected rows; zero rows carry n_candidates == 0), so the absolute Macro-F1 values are CONDITIONAL_HELD_OUT / DEPRECATED_ABSOLUTE rather than all-event canonical.
The relative verdict is unchanged: on a no-candidate snapshot both arms predict source-only, so restoring those rows moves both arms toward the same value and cannot turn the negative delta positive.
protocol_issues_discovered_later: Bootstrap multiplicity bug (with-replacement resample collapsed into a unique-event dict) made the original CIs invalid; the corrected CIs are in e3_failure_diagnosis/bootstrap_fixed.json.
No-candidate snapshots were skipped in the held-out run (scope audit CASE_B); the all-event held-out evidence cell is now listed as a MUST_HAVE gap.

stages.main_objective: Explain why Dynamic V1 failed to improve on static despite a validation readiness pass.
known_caveats: All diagnosis is post-hoc on the frozen held-out runs; no causal claim is made.
The proxy's insensitivity to evidence set replacement is a proxy property, not a general reader property.

stages.main_objective: Re-evaluate E2 and E3-V1 with every event kept at every real cutoff (candidate_count = 0 included) instead of conditioning on candidate_count > 0.
stages.gate_definition: protocol correction: conditioned evaluation is prohibited

e2_all_event_vs_old.note: values are [new_all_event, old_candidates_only] mean over runs

known_caveats: The correction is a protocol finding; it changed metric denominators, so pre-correction absolute numbers are DEPRECATED.
Ma-Weibo has a much lower 5m no-candidate rate (12.7%) than PHEME (35.5%), so conditioning affected PHEME more.

stages.stage_name: Dynamic V2 / MF-TSR validation — marginal-fidelity set refinement
model_components_used: MF-TSR set refiner (ADD/REMOVE, teacher-KL fidelity objective)
stages.main_objective: Refine the static evidence set so that the proxy's full-graph distribution is preserved, using a set-level marginal-fidelity objective instead of point-wise reranking.
stages.gate_definition: MF-TSR Macro-F1 - Static Macro-F1 >= -0.002 with token reduction >= 30% and no relative flip increase > 5%
known_caveats: Set refinement did change the context substantially (set change rate 0.56-0.98) yet the proxy decision barely moved.
Teacher-KL distortion reduction is not equivalent to downstream discriminative sufficiency.

stages.stage_name: Dynamic V3-A / MS-TSR proxy validation — minimal-sufficient temporal set refinement
model_components_used: dual-view consensus gate (C1) + signed-margin gate (C2, alpha)
stages.main_objective: Find a minimum-cost evidence subset that preserves the static decision (C1) and retains a fraction alpha of the static signed margin (C2).
stages.gate_definition: Delta Macro-F1 >= -0.002 AND token reduction >= 30% AND relative flip increase <= 5%
known_caveats: Delta Macro-F1 = 0 is a structural consequence of condition C1 plus static fallback, not an empirical gain; the classification part of the gate carries no evidential weight.
The proxy is insensitive to evidence substitution, so proxy-level 'no loss' does not imply real-reader 'no loss'.
Fold-local alpha collapsed to the loosest grid point (0.8) in every fold, so the C2 margin never bound.
protocol_issues_discovered_later: The alpha freeze to 0.8 in every fold motivated freezing alpha = 0.8 for the V3-B reader pilot.

stages.stage_name: Dynamic V3-B — Frozen Qwen3-8B reader-transfer pilot
stages.main_objective: Test whether the minimal-sufficient social context defined by the frozen proxy transfers to a completely independent frozen Qwen3-8B reader.
stages.primary_comparator: Static reader arm (static selected evidence rendered with the identical prompt)
stages.gate_definition: Delta Macro-F1 >= -0.005 AND social token reduction >= 30% AND unsupported citation rate <= 1%
known_caveats: Validation-only pilot; the PHEME point estimate is not statistically significant (bootstrap CI crosses zero).
Not final held-out evidence and must not be placed in a test table.
The pilot mixes five outer-fold validation pools, so it cannot be used to design a global heuristic without contaminating the original test split.
protocol_issues_discovered_later: Cross-fold contamination: 285/285 PHEME and 275/275 Ma-Weibo sampled events also appear in another fold's test split (rate 1.0).

stages.main_objective: Explain why proxy-defined sufficiency transferred on PHEME but failed on Ma-Weibo.
stages.gate_definition: diagnostic only (fixed thresholds fixed before analysis)
known_caveats: Post-hoc diagnostic on 600 validation samples; no new Qwen inference.
A root cause that was not triggered under the predefined rule is not proven absent.
No proxy-side signal cleared the fixed thresholds, so no reader-calibration rule is justified.
protocol_issues_discovered_later: Structural degree/leaf extraction used edge positions as degree-map keys; fixed in the finalization stage.

stages.stage_name: V3-B failure diagnosis finalization (structural bug fix)
model_components_used: same frozen artifacts as V3-B diagnosis (deterministic feature re-extraction only)
stages.main_objective: Fix the structural degree/leaf bug (edge position vs node ID) and confirm that no root cause or recommendation changes.
stages.gate_definition: diagnostic only; frozen hashes must be unchanged or FROZEN_ARTIFACT_VIOLATION
known_caveats: The fix touched only degree / leaf / child-count structural diagnostics; it did not change any detection, compression, citation or margin result.
After the fix, no stable reader-risk structural signal emerged; the largest difference (Ma-Weibo retained vs removed source-child rate 0.699 vs 0.852) remains a candidate observation only.
